exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because the declared module set is not yet complete across ole32 COM marshaling, side-by-side activation context, and msvbvm, and the real-corpus gap budget cannot be re-measured in this worktree (no staged payload). The kernel32 breadth slice exists generically in the HLE core (lib/hle.mjs): the stdcall string family (lstrcmpA/W, lstrcmpiA/W with the ordinal <0/0/>0 contract, and lstrcpyA/W, lstrcpynA, lstrcatA/W returning the destination pointer over the checked guest memory model), the interlocked atomics (InterlockedIncrement/Decrement returning the new value, InterlockedExchange/ExchangeAdd returning the prior value, and InterlockedCompareExchange storing only on a comparand match — trivially atomic under the one declared guest thread), MulDiv with the round-half-away-from-zero contract and the -1 zero-denominator and overflow refusal, GetSystemInfo/GetNativeSystemInfo writing the declared single-processor SYSTEM_INFO, GetSystemTime/GetLocalTime writing a SYSTEMTIME derived from the one guest clock at the declared UTC bias, SetErrorMode/GetErrorMode over the declared process error mode, and OutputDebugStringA/W as the no-observable-effect debug sink with a bounded read.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every declared module passes its conformance slice with the ledger holding the gap budget.
expected_failing_assertion: The ole32 marshaling, side-by-side activation, and msvbvm module slices are absent, so the declared module set does not all pass.
